title: Config. Packages with Native AL XML Data Types
summary: Codeunit Config. Excel Exchange is refactored to use native AL XML Data Types instead of legacy XML handling, enabling cloud-ready development for the RapidStart feature.
key_points: Complete refactoring of Config. Excel Exchange codeunit to use native XML Data Types
Improves cloud readiness for partner app development
Functional behavior remains unchanged with expanded test coverage
Updates supporting XML DOM Management and related configuration modules
Tests added to validate new methods match previous implementation
